title: M9.8: Rust on RV32 in the explorer (no_std) and native Rust practice language
description: Rust via rustc --emit asm,obj and a no_std runtime crate for the emulator; native Rust as a fourth practice language later. See docs/m9-plan.md for costs (about 590 MB image growth) and noise caveats.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Decision (maintainer, 2026-10-06): Rust is first class and goes in with everything else; the maintainer also wants to learn Rust. Plan: (1) Rust as a fourth native practice language in the shared runner image (rustc only, no cargo), (2) Rust in the Compilation Explorer on riscv32im-unknown-none-elf with a small no_std runtime crate (println, read_line, alloc via a bump allocator), (3) a Rust curriculum track (see M13). Image growth (about 590 MB) is accepted; measure cold start (SIE-1bb769) and mitigate if needed.

right_now_summary: Rust support is being added to the shared runner and RISC-V explorer, with a native practice track planned.
